# The path extended to the right wall. Let me try UP to see if the path turns upward
# Also let me check the current state of the path end

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find the rightmost path node
max_col = 0
rightmost = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 6:
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        if max_c > max_col:
            max_col = max_c
            rightmost = n

print(f"Rightmost path node: id={rightmost['id']} color={rightmost['color']} boundary={rightmost['boundary']}")

# Try UP to see if the path turns
result = action(['UP'])
print("\nAfter UP - board_changed:", result.get('board_changed'), "gameplay_changed:", result.get('gameplay_changed'), "no_impact:", result.get('no_impact'))

# Check what changed
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
max_col2 = 0
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 6:
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if max_c >= max_col - 2:  # Near the right edge
            print(f"  Right-edge node: id={n['id']} color={n['color']} boundary={n['boundary']}")

# Check path-to-block adjacency again
path_ids = set()
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 6:
        path_ids.add(n['id'])

for a in seg2['adjacency_list']:
    i, j = a
    if i in path_ids or j in path_ids:
        ni = next((n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['id'] == i), None)
        nj = next((n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['id'] == j), None)
        if ni and nj and (ni['color'] in ('R','b','N') or nj['color'] in ('R','b','N')):
            print(f"  CONNECTION: {i}({ni['color']}) - {j}({nj['color']})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
